subject: [PATCH v4 3/7] sched/numa: scan read-only file mappings in tiering mode

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch and applied his Acked-by tag without raising any specific technical concerns or suggestions.

2026-09-30.patch_summary: This patch series addresses an issue in the NUMA balancing code, where read-only file mappings are not scanned for promotion when tiering is enabled. The patch introduces a new walk type for each VMA based on the balancing mode snapshot taken in task_numa_work(). This change ensures that hot file folios on slow memory are retained and prevents east-west placement bouncing.
